sermon.title: They Which Lead You 11/11/2018
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer teaches that those who lead can cause people to err, so the Bible gives leaders requirements, not just traits: just, wise, decisive, organized, compassionate, innovative and industrious. He applies them to rulers, church leaders, husbands, wives and older women who teach younger women.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear.

faqs.question: Does the Constitution set moral requirements for leaders?
Socialist vs. communist?
faqs.answer: He says communists take your property; socialists tell you what to do with it.

faqs.question: What is the power of God unto salvation?
Boss vs. leader?
faqs.answer: A boss is pulled by the workers; a leader is out front.

faqs.question: What does he say about tongues?
faqs.answer: Forbid not to speak in tongues.

faqs.question: What does he say about Trump?
faqs.answer: He’s crude and rude, but trying to stop illegal immigration.

faqs.question: When may you leave a marriage?
faqs.answer: He says violence that can’t be corrected or sexual immorality.

faqs.question: What has God made us?
faqs.answer: Kings and priests who shall reign on earth.

scriptures.text_nkjv: And have made us kings and priests to our God; And we shall reign on the earth.”
